title: Headless Hard Luck Blues (VES34Vault): Morgan Blake's failing crops, the East Pump Station's readings, Vault 34's reactor shut down from the master override to save the farms (stage 30, completed at 50)

actions.text: Path: Morgan Blake at the Aerotech sharecropper farms asks the player to look at the pump station (stage 10); the East Pump Station terminal shows the radiation comes from outside (20); in Vault 34 the reactor terminal points to the master override (25, objective 40 offered); the master override's first entry shuts the reactor down (30: the farms saved, NCR fame, stage 50 completes the quest). The other ending, the survivors saved (40, then 60), is the override's second entry.
Stand-in for the trip to the sharecropper farms.
Stand-in for the trip to the East Pump Station.
Stand-in for the trip through Vault 34's flooded, irradiated halls to the reactor.
